2608.20809.title: TRACE: Training-time Report-guided and Clinically Ordered Concept Editing
2608.20809.paper_summary: Breast ultrasound diagnosis relies on clinically meaningful semantic concepts, yet most deep learning methods adopt end-to-end image-to-label paradigms that lack interpretability and robustness. While concept-based approaches offer a promising alternative, they often assume complete annotations or require multimodal inputs at inference, which significantly limits their real-world applicability. To tackle these issues, we propose Training-time Report-guided and Clinically Ordered Concept Editing (TRACE), a training-time report-guided framework that leverages structured radiology reports as privileged concept supervision while enabling image-only diagnosis at test time. TRACE refines image-derived concepts through a teacher-guided editing mechanism within a malignancy-aware ordered concept space. To address incomplete annotations, we introduce Strategic Concept Missing Training (SCMT) and train an image-only self-editor via edit distillation for autonomous concept refinement. Besides, we introduce BUSC, a concept-enriched benchmark linking images, labels, and structured attributes. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that TRACE achieves superior performance and improved cross-domain robustness compared to existing methods.
2608.20809.paper_summary_zh: 乳腺超音波診斷依賴臨床上有意義的語義概念，然而大多數深度學習方法採用端到端的圖像到標籤範式，缺乏可解釋性和穩健性。雖然基於概念的方法提供了一個有前景的替代方案，但它們通常假設有完整的註解或在推理時需要多模態輸入，這大大限制了它們在現實世界中的適用性。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了訓練時報告引導和臨床排序概念編輯（TRACE），這是一個訓練時報告引導的框架，利用結構化的放射學報告作為特權概念監督，同時在測試時實現僅基於圖像的診斷。TRACE通過一種教師引導的編輯機制在一個關注惡性腫瘤的有序概念空間中精煉圖像衍生的概念。為了解決不完整的註解問題，我們引入了戰略性概念缺失訓練（SCMT），並通過編輯蒸餾訓練一個僅基於圖像的自我編輯器，以實現自主的概念精煉。此外，我們還引入了BUSC，一個概念豐富的基準，將圖像、標籤和結構化屬性聯繫起來。多個數據集的實驗表明，TRACE在性能和跨域穩健性方面優於現有方法。
